d: The American University in the Emirates (AUE) is looking for a Senior Accountant to support the university’s financial operations. This role is responsible for accurate accounting records, timely month-end and year-end closing, reconciliations, and financial reporting, in compliance with accounting standards and regulatory requirements. The Senior Accountant works closely with the Finance Manager and with academic and administrative departments.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
CPA, ACCA, CMA, or an equivalent professional certification is highly preferred.
Fluency in English is required; Arabic is an advantage.
Experience in higher education is an advantage.
A minimum of [5] years of accounting experience, including at least [2] years in a senior accountant role or equivalent.
Experience in the higher education sector or a large, complex organization is an advantage.
Strong knowledge of accounting principles, IFRS, and UAE VAT requirements.
Proficiency in ERP and accounting systems, and advanced Excel skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with high attention to detail.
Ability to meet deadlines and work independently in a multi-task environment.
Good communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to explain financial information clearly.
Maintain the general ledger and ensure accurate recording of all financial transactions.
Prepare the month-end and year-end closing, including accruals, prepayments, and adjustments.
Prepare and review bank, supplier, and intercompany reconciliations.
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and management reports.
Oversee accounts payable and receivable, including student tuition receivables and collections follow-up.
Review payroll accounting entries and maintain the fixed assets register and depreciation.
Prepare and file VAT returns and support tax compliance.
Support the preparation and monitoring of the annual budget and variance analysis.
Support internal and external audits by preparing schedules and responding to queries.
Ensure compliance with internal controls, university policies, and regulatory requirements.
Guide and review the work of junior accountants and accounting staff.
Recommend improvements to accounting processes and systems.
Perform any other duties assigned by the Finance Manager or the university’s leadership.
About American University in the Emirates (AUE)

The American University in the Emirates (AUE) invites applications from well-qualified candidates for a range of faculty and administrative positions. AUE is located in Dubai International Academic City.
AUE is not just a place of learning but a hub of innovation and growth, where your expertise and aspirations find a welcoming environment.
At AUE, we believe Nothing is Impossible is the Pathway to Success.

AUE comprises eight dynamic colleges: College of Law, College of Education, College of Design, College of Business Administration, College of Health Sciences, College of Media and Mass Communication, College of Computer Information Technology and College of Security and Strategic Studies. Each college boasts unique strengths and prestigious accreditations, reflecting our commitment to providing a world-class education.

The American University in the Emirates is accredited by SACSCOC (the Southern Association of Colleges and Schools Commission on Colleges) to award baccalaureate and master’s degrees. Degree-granting institutions also offer credentials such as certificates and diplomas at approved degree levels.

The American University in the Emirates is officially licensed to operate as a higher education institution and all its programs are accredited by CAA (the Commission for Academic Accreditation), Ministry of Education, United Arab Emirates.

The College of Business Administration is a proud member of AACSB (The Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business), and its degree programs (Bachelor of Business Administration, Master of Business Administration, Master of Sport Management) have been accredited by AACSB since 2022.
The Bachelor of Computer Science in the College of Computer Information Technology is accredited by the Computing Accreditation Commission of ABET.

NASAD (The National Association of Schools of Art and Design) has granted the Bachelor of Science in Fashion Design, Bachelor of Science in Graphic Design, Bachelor of Science in Interior Design, and Bachelor of Science in Animation in the College of Design the designation of Substantial Equivalency with accredited programs in the United States.
